Rules.title: Game Rules
Rules.pronoWinnerBody: Predict the right outcome (home win, draw, away win) before kick-off. You earn Points indexed on real market odds: the more unlikely the result, the more it pays. The asymptotic formula caps gains at 220 Points maximum to preserve the game economy.
Rules.pronoScoreBody: Go beyond the outcome and hit the exact score. If you're in the right camp AND few players found that exact score among those with the right outcome, you earn the Counter Pick bonus: +10 Points (> 40%), +30 Points (Nice Move), +60 Points (The Visionary), or +100 Points (💎 The Heist — under 5%!). The goal: surprise the community.
Rules.pronoScorersBody: Name one or more scorers before the match. Each scorer found earns Points based on the player's real odds — defenders and midfielders earn more than expected strikers. Odds are calculated with an asymptotic formula capped at 150 Points per scorer, cumulative.
Rules.liveWazeTitle: The Waze System — Report an action
Rules.liveWazeBody: During the match, if you spot a contentious action (penalty, VAR offside, card…), press the corresponding button. If enough players confirm within 30 seconds, a betting market opens automatically. The threshold is dynamic: on a small, less-visited match, 1 signal is enough. On a big match, more are needed to avoid spam.
Rules.liveWindowBody: You have 90 seconds to stake Sifflets on YES (the referee validates) or NO (reversed decision). After this delay, bets are closed and we wait for the verdict.
Rules.liveParimutelBody: Odds are not fixed: they move in real time based on all players' stakes. More on YES → the YES odds drop. It's pari-mutuel, like horse racing. The displayed odds are an estimate (~Odds) until closing.
Rules.liveGlobalPotBody: You play against the rest of the app, not just your friends. Sifflets from players across the whole community who are wrong fund the gains of those with the right instinct. Private leagues are for rankings and trash talk — the pot is global.
Rules.liveKarmaBody: Each alert you trigger impacts your trust score. True alert (YES): +2 pts. False alert (NO): −5 pts. If your score drops too low, your alerts are silently ignored by the system.
Rules.championshipAdversaryBody: In 1v1 mode, the league owner generates a complete round-robin schedule (home and away). Each week, you are automatically matched against a different member. The schedule is calculated from the championship launch.
Rules.championshipScoreTitle: Picks + VAR Bets = your weekly score
Rules.championshipScoreBody: Your weekly 'score' combines two sources: your pick points (exact score, scorers) AND your net gains from live VAR bets (YES/NO). Everything you win during the week counts — pre-match consistency AND live instinct.
Rules.championshipVictoryBody: At the end of the week, the player with the most pick Points wins the 'match'. Win = 3 Points in the standings, Draw (tie) = 1 Point each, Loss = 0 Points. In case of a perfect tie in the overall standings, total pick Points serve as goal difference.
Rules.championshipClosedBody: Once the championship is launched, no more players can join the league. The number of members must be even (2 to 18) for the schedule to be balanced.
Rules.seasonNewStartBody: On the 1st of every month, the seasonal ranking is frozen and archived. Sifflets earned are carried over at 10% into the new season to give everyone a real chance to shine — no matter when you join.
Rules.seasonHallOfFameBody: Your total cumulative points (across all seasons) are never erased. They feed your personal Hall of Fame — a permanent record of all your performances.
Rules.seasonRanksBody: At the close of each season: Champion (1st), Top 3, Top 10, Participant. These ranks are archived in your profile forever.

Laws.title: VAR Laws of the Game
Laws.subtitle: The 4 official situations where video assistance can intervene.
Laws.source: Source: IFAB Laws of the Game 2024/25 — FIFA VAR Protocol
Laws.sit01Body: VAR intervenes to check whether a goal should be awarded or disallowed. This includes fouls in the buildup to the goal, offside positions, and involuntary or deliberate handballs in the attacking phase.
Laws.sit02Body: Any decision to award or deny a penalty in the box may be reviewed. VAR also checks whether players were within the penalty area at the time of the shot.
Laws.sit03Subtitle: Serious foul play or violent conduct
Laws.sit03Body: Direct red cards (not second yellows) can be reviewed: dangerous tackles, brutality, spitting, biting. A mistaken yellow can be upgraded, but VAR does not review double bookings.
Laws.sit04Body: If the referee sanctions the wrong player — card or dismissal — VAR corrects the identity. This case remains rare but has been covered by the official IFAB protocol since 2018.
Laws.principle01Body: VAR only intervenes for clear errors. A referee cannot be overruled for subjective judgments.
Laws.principle02Body: VAR recommends, the referee decides. He can go to the pitchside monitor (OFR — On Field Review) to decide for himself.
Laws.principle03Body: By protocol, players must wait for VAR validation before celebrating a goal. The referee raises his hand to signal the check.
